title: Hardware engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Hardware engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in ManausLocationManaus, Amazonas, Brazil RoleHardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM LevelMid-Level (1-3 years of experience) TypeFull-Time, On-Site LanguagesPortuguese & English required · Spanish a plusAbout Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.Learn more about Quectel: Company website —Our history & global footprint —LATAM in action —Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us onLinked InThe Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market."Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay."What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's fullproduct portfolio— cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectelservices— including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action —Quectel customer storiesfrom automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more.Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.Apply via:sasha.saini@|Browse open roles:

title: Hardware engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Hardware engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deNefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Financial advisor
description:
Empresa está contratando Financial advisor em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360o. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes. O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente. Responsabilidades e Atribuições: Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida. Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações Requisitos e Qualificações: Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento Certificação CPA (mínimo) ou em andamento Diferencial: Certificações CFP, CEA, Ancord, PQO Diferencial: Inglês intermediário ou avançado O que oferecemos? Ambiente colaborativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento profissional; Treinamentos e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento das suas habilidades; Incentivo intelectual. title: Professor de inglês (foco em aviação)
description:
Confira a vaga para Professor de inglês (foco em aviação) em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre NósNa English Journey, nós não apenas ensinamos um novo idioma; nós conectamos pessoas aos seus maiores objetivos de vida e carreira. Somos uma escola focada no ensino de inglês para propósitos específicos, preparando nossos alunos para o mercado global, processos seletivos internacionais, aviação, turismo e realocação. Buscamos profissionais dinâmicos, que tenham paixão pelo ensino e que queiram fazer parte dessa jornada de crescimento. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Ministrar aulas de inglês (online/presenciais) de forma dinâmica, comunicativa e focada nas necessidades do aluno. Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e treinamentos internos para alinhamento metodológico. Manter os registros de presença e evolução dos alunos atualizados em nosso sistema. Requisitos e Qualificações Fluência em inglês (excelente domínio de conversação, escrita e escuta). Experiência prévia no ensino do idioma (experiência com inglês para fins específicos/corporativo será um diferencial). Ótima comunicação, empatia, didática e paixão por ensinar. Organização e pontualidade com prazos e horários. Se a vaga for para o formato Online: Possuir computador com boa conexão de internet, ambiente silencioso para as aulas, câmera de boa qualidade e facilidade com ferramentas digitais (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.). title: Designer/diretor de arte hands-on
description:
Confira a vaga para Designer/diretor de arte hands-on em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Vaga Temporária – Criação (Designer/Diretor de Arte Hands-on) – 100% remota Período: 1 a 31 de julho Dedicação: Integral, 100% remoto Localização da agência: São Paulo (atendimento nacional) Sobre a UAI Brasil Somos uma boutique de comunicação especializada em saúde. Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos, criando soluções taylor made que traduzem ciência em cuidado. Entregamos visão, estratégia e execução com sensibilidade, compliance e foco em resultados. Nossa experiência vai de campanhas institucionais e promocionais na área da saúde a comunicação interna e eventos, sempre com responsabilidade e criatividade. O que buscamos Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional híbrido(a), entre os níveis júnior e pleno, para cobrir férias de um membro da equipe de criação. Temos uma grande demanda diária de peças de comunicação e precisamos de uma pessoa com disponibilidade e dedicação integrais. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente sob coordenação da direção de arte e Heads de Atendimento. Desenvolver peças digitais e físicas para: Comunicação interna (cards, e-mails, vídeos para TV corporativa, cartazes, banners, paineis); Campanhas institucionais e de produtos para saúde; Materiais para eventos em geral. Criar materiais visuais alinhados aos briefings, com proatividade e soluções criativas. Apoiar demandas de campanhas e projetos pontuais em saúde. Editar vídeos em motion design em nível intermediário para pequenas demandas do dia a dia. Preparar apresentações para campanhas e outras necessidades dos clientes. Requisitos Experiência comprovada em design gráfico e digital. Domínio de ferramentas: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design, After Effects e ferramentas de IA aplicadas a design e vídeo. Utilizamos também como apoio no dia a dia, especialmente para apresentações internas, Canva, Cap Cut, Clip Champ e outros. Com IA, incorporamos ao nosso trabalho o uso de ferramentas diversas do pacote Magnific (ex-Free Pik). Perfil proativo, organizado e colaborativo. Capacidade de equilibrar execução técnica com visão criativa. Disponibilidade integral durante o período da vaga. Diferenciais Habilidade em motion design (nível intermediário). Experiência, mesmo que inicial, com ferramentas de IA para criação de imagens e animações simples. Habilidade com apresentações em PPT e/ou Canva. Experiência prévia em comunicação corporativa ou saúde. Informações importantes Contrato temporário: 1 mês (1 a 31 de julho). Importante: temos possibilidade de tornar esta vaga permanente. Neste momento, garantimos somente a contratação temporária, mas estamos com alguns projetos em andamento que podem possibilitar uma nova negociação, se houver interesse, com extensão de contrato. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto. PJ. Pretensão salarial: informar no envio da candidatura (fundamental para agilizar a seleção). Envie seu portfólio e pretensão salarial para: Assunto: Vaga Temporária Criação – Julho 2026

title: Customer success manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer success manager em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You’ll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

description:

Role OverviewSyntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Process Engineering(Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.Required Qualifications & SkillsTechnical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication:Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Sua Conquista: PLR e licença prêmio. Festividades: Auxílio ceia de Natal e meio dia de folga no aniversário. Clube de vantagens: Descontos em estudos e benefícios em diversos serviços e estabelecimentos. Benefícios para a família: Check-up de exames laboratoriais para os pais no mês de aniversário do colaborador e R$ 1 mil por ano em exames laboratoriais para os dependentes legais, auxílio babá ou creche, desconto na compra do material escolar no início do ano letivo, licença maternidade e paternidade estendida e programa de gestação. Atenção: Benefícios referentes a Brasília, nas demais regiões podem sofrer alterações; A elegibilidade de alguns benefícios depende de tempo mínimo de permanência na empresa. Observações Analisamos as candidaturas com muita atenção, cuidado e consideração. Entraremos em contato com os candidatos mais aderentes ao perfil da vaga; Recebemos um número expressivo de inscrições, por isso, a convocação para a vaga desejada pode não acontecer de forma imediata. NOSSO PROPÓSITO É INSPIRAR PESSOAS A CUIDAR DE PESSOAS. SE VOCÊ SE IDENTIFICA, NOS CONHEÇA UM POUCO MAIS E CANDIDATE-SE! Referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, dedicado às melhores práticas sustentáveis e atuante nas comunidades onde está presente, o Grupo Sabin nasceu na capital federal, fruto da coragem e determinação de duas empreendedoras, Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, em 1984. Hoje conta com cerca de 7000 colaboradores unidos pelo propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas. Presente em 14 estados, além do Distrito Federal, a empresa oferece serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental às 354 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país. O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra um portfólio de negócios que contempla análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo. Além disso, contempla também serviços de atenção primária, contribuindo para a gestão de saúde de grupos populacionais por meio de programas e linhas de cuidados coordenados, com a Amparo Saúde, e a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde - Rita Saúde - solução digital que conta com diversos parceiros como farmácias, médicos e outros profissionais, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência. Com o objetivo de fomentar o empreendedorismo na saúde, o Grupo lançou, em 2020, o ;– um hub de inovação que atua na promoção e no desenvolvimento de startups, estimulando parcerias, troca de conhecimento e a construção de modelos de negócio que contribuam para o setor de saúde com base na ciência, eficiência e experiência do cliente. Como uma empresa nacional sólida, visionária, com valores bem estabelecidos, comprometida com uma agenda ESG de forma genuína e serviços de saúde e bem-estar para apoiar a jornada de saúde de seus clientes, de Norte a Sul do país, o Grupo Sabin é mantenedor do Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 trabalha ações de impacto social nas comunidades onde a empresa está presente, com foco na melhoria da qualidade de vida, do bem-estar e da prosperidade dessas comunidades, fomentando a inovação social. Nessa trajetória o Instituto impactou positivamente a vida de mais de 1,6 milhões de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais. Conheça nossos processos seletivos, fique por dentro das vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin espalhadas por todo Brasil. Afinal, investimos em processos formulados para trazer para o nosso Grupo pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores. Fique atento e evite cair em golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para a participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.
